description: "Is this fog organic, or engineered?" - Inverse of manufactured-consensus-detection: test whether noise, contradiction, and over-supplied mutually exclusive explanations around a claim are organic uncertainty or engineered to prevent ANY conclusion. Use when (1) every source tells a different story with suspicious completeness, (2) obvious questions stay unanswered while exotic ones get saturated coverage, (3) contradictory leaks arrive faster than verification is possible, (4) "we may never know" circulates where evidence should exist. Does NOT trigger for: ordinary uncertainty from genuinely thin evidence, or fresh events still developing.
